title: Pagasa: Rains from Choi-Wan to persist over Visayas, Mindanao

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The trough of a typhoon outside the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR) will continue to bring rains over Visayas and Mindanao, while Metro Manila may see fair weather conditions in the coming days, the state weather bureau said. Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) reported in its 5 p.m. weather advisory that the extension of Typhoon Choi-Wan will bring scattered rains and thunderstorms over Mindanao, Western Visayas, Negros Island Region, Central Visayas, and Southern Leyte on Sunday, Oct. 4.
